summary: Preserved PR 1027's valid host-independent backend-selection regression and added the missing exact-shape TP=4 routed-expert loader contract. The loader fixture passes on the candidate's unchanged production source, so no production correction is justified without the checkpoint and SM90 hardware.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the physical ROCm platform leaked into the nominal SM100 selection case on the candidate parent.
Passing-after evidence for the retained candidate change: mocked SM90, SM100, and SM120 backend selection is host-independent.
Four TP ranks load reported [2048, 2048] packed weights and [2048, 128] scales into 512-row local shards with FlashInfer [up; gate] W13 ordering.
Module skipped because the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X is not an NVIDIA SM90 GPU; no Hopper kernel claim is made.

tests.what_was_measured: One assigned gfx950 GPU executed a float32 matrix multiply equal to its CPU reference; unrelated to FlashInfer kernel qualification.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-1c25a60d5089/evidence/gpu-check.txt records AMD Instinct MI350X and matches_cpu True. The SM90 suite skipped.
remaining_limitations: NVIDIA SM90/H800 hardware was unavailable; FlashInfer Hopper preprocessing and kernel execution remain unverified.
Full model loading, four-process TP=4 execution, DSPARK, HTTP serving, and semantic accuracy were not reproduced.
The exact-shape deterministic fixture proves the loader/sharding contract only; it does not establish why the reporter's release environment raised Hidden size mismatch.
